business_summary: LEAP India Limited provides asset pooling and supply chain solutions in India. The company offers pallet, container, crate, and material handling equipment pooling and rental services, as well as provides forklift rental services, electronic data interchange services, asset management services, collaborative transportation services, repair and maintenance services, and inventory management services. It also offers material handling equipment solutions, and other supply chain infrastructure products. The company's products are used in retail, electronics, and automobile applications. LEAP India Limited was incorporated in 2013 and is based in Mumbai, India.
